role: App Store reviewer-notes template and the pre-upload physical-device release flow-walk checklist; referenced by runbooks/hotfix.md and runbooks/app-store-rejection.md.
toplevel: Markdown only. The demo path and UI strings it quotes must match the shipped build; nothing checks them automatically.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk
units.does: No behavioural claim: says the file serves App Review and the release flow-walk, and is referenced by hotfix.md and app-store-rejection.md (both exist in docs/runbooks/).

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > What the reviewer must be told
units.does: Claims the two review problems: no strap means no data, and the main flow takes a night. No code claim.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > What the reviewer must be told > Reviewer notes template
units.does: Claims reviewer path: Dashboard shows 'No strap yet? Explore with sample data' under 'Building your baseline'; loading adds three weeks of synthetic nights (DemoSessionSeeder.defaultNightCount = 21, DemoSessionSeeder.swift:66) scored by the real pipeline, tagged Demo, with a banner and 'Remove sample data'; same control at More → Settings → Troubleshooting → Sample data → 'Load sample data'; paywall after onboarding with $0 trial + unlock, reachable at Settings → Purchase, Restore Purchases; Flo setup strings ('Set up Flo', 'Add an API key', 'Save key', 'Send and remember for', 'Choose model', 'Report response', 'Withdraw consent', "Don't send") all exist in Swift sources; keys in Keychain; iCloud sync off by default and excludes Health data; background modes audio/bluetooth-central/bluetooth-peripheral/location (Info.plist:22-28), audio described as voice chat plus workout cues spoken from the background with no keep-alive (session active only while a cue is audible, BackgroundAudioManager beginCue/endCue) and sensor workouts kept running by bluetooth-central wakeups, matching BackgroundAudioManager.swift:3-21; assistant declines rhythm/diagnostic questions and answers self-harm with crisis resources on device.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Release flow-walk
units.does: No behavioural claim: release flow-walk must be done on a physical device in Release with a real strap.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Release flow-walk > Onboarding and permissions
units.does: Checklist: fresh install onboarding, disclaimer acknowledgement, HealthKit deny/grant, Bluetooth deny explains. Manual; no code claim beyond existence of disclaimer gate (runLaunchTask).

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Release flow-walk > Recording — the core path
units.does: Checklist: pair strap, overnight in background, reconnect after range loss with visible gap, crash recovery restores beats, stop produces archived score. Manual.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Release flow-walk > Morning results
units.does: Checklist: score/breakdown render without NaN, re-analyze, sleep-timeline edit recomputes, PDF export. Manual.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Release flow-walk > Workouts and Watch
units.does: Checklist: outdoor GPS workout, indoor workout with HR-threshold audio cues while locked, Watch start/live metrics/relaunch restore. Manual.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Release flow-walk > AI assistant
units.does: Checklist: Apple Intelligence default, Set up Flo without a key, Choose model lists models, Gemini consent states free/paid terms, markdown heading renders bold, consent sheet before first hosted send, consent date + Withdraw consent, key removal withdraws consent, medical question declined without send, self-harm crisis reply on device. Manual.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Release flow-walk > Paywall and entitlements
units.does: Checklist: paywall reachable on fresh install, TestFlight shows the same paywall, trial start then unlock-only, Xcode builds show 'Full access is already active on this device.' (string exists), sandbox purchase, restore on second device. Manual.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Release flow-walk > Data deletion
units.does: Checklist: More → Settings → Advanced Data Controls → Delete All My Data with typed confirmation (DeleteAllDataPage requires 'DELETE MY DATA', DeleteAllDataPage.swift:28); sessions, backups, conversations, keys, settings removed; remote copy removed online; airplane mode completes locally and tells the user to re-run. Manual.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Release flow-walk > Accessibility and localisation
units.does: Checklist: VoiceOver, largest text size, Arabic RTL, Japanese CJK, Reduce Motion/Increase Contrast. Manual.

units.key: § App Review — reviewer notes and release flow-walk > Before you upload
units.does: Checklist: make ci passes, uploaded commit matches, privacy answers match PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy/consent sheet/policy, no undeclared required-reason API, notes current, sample-data entry visible on fresh Dashboard and removal returns to 'Get started'. Manual.
